summary: Name the required location of a misplaced delivery field in GOV-INTENT-002 (issue 517)

delivery.outcome: A GOV-INTENT-002 delivery error for a recognized field at the wrong level names its required path, e.g. move interfaceChanges to delivery.architecture.interfaceChanges, so the fix is one mechanical move instead of an intent rewrite.
nonGoals: No synonym: a misplaced field stays rejected
Unknown fields get no location hint and stay rejected
No change to the AGENTS template or host projections

architecture.decision: governance_check.py keeps one DELIVERY_FIELD_PATHS map of every recognized delivery, budget and architecture field to its required path; field_set_hint takes it as an optional located map and appends 'move X to PATH' for unexpected keys it knows. The delivery, budgets and architecture validators pass the map. The bundled Wellman copy stays byte-identical.
interfaceChanges: GOV-INTENT-002 delivery message names the required path of a misplaced recognized field
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit; the message lists the unexpected field without its location.
